A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same COUPLE paper, with all 41 pages and Appendices A–E available. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical content except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: Sections 5–6 and Appendix C report original benchmark experiments, human evaluations, ablations, and sensitivity analyses.

after.justification: Sections 5–6 and Appendix C retain the same original experimental results, including benchmark comparisons and human evaluations.

M1.justification: The SCM, value attribution, intervention, counterfactual prediction, and naive/reasoning-based fine-tuning procedures are identical in Section 4 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Touché23-ValueEval and DailyDilemma coverage, country/group and role profiles, and supplementary PVQ evaluation. No dataset or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in the corresponding main and appendix experiments, including Role Prompt, Value Prompt, Tree of Thought, Plan and Solve, the cultural-alignment baselines, and VIM.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix B retain identical model configurations, training/evaluation splits, MAE and correlation metrics, and human-evaluation procedures. No experimental settings are revised.

E4.justification: The component ablations, value-complexity and steerability analyses, interpretability studies, and cases are unchanged. Appendix C.6 retains the same unrelated-value interventions, priority-preservation analysis, and concept-count and intervention-threshold sensitivity tests.

E5.justification: Significance markers, captions, and statistical-reporting statements are identical. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including appendix results. For example, Table 2 reports COUPLE's GPT-4.1-mini Touché23-ValueEval MAE of 1.433 and correlation of 0.778 in both versions.

T1.justification: The task definitions, causal formalism, structural equations, and mathematical descriptions in Sections 3–4 and Appendix A are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about addressing value complexity and steerability through COUPLE and achieving accurate, controllable, interpretable alignment.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and limitations are unchanged. Section 7 and Appendix E retain the same qualifications concerning model capability, value representation, cultural generalization, scalability, and evaluator bias.

D1.justification: Appendices A–B provide identical prompts, calibration details, hyperparameters, hardware, data-processing instructions, and code/data-access information.

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list, and the positioning relative to prior alignment and causal-reasoning research are identical.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v1, dated 21 Oct 2025, to v2, dated 5 Dec 2025. The paper's prose, terminology, headings, and organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, and page layouts are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. Renderings differ only in the version/date stamp recorded under P1.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and presentation are identical across both PDFs, including the appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in paper quality.
